import type { GeospatialCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import { flyGeospatialCameraToAsync } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export interface Place { yaw: number; pitch: number; radius: number; center: { x: number; y: number; z: number } }

type Vec3Like = { x: number; y: number; z: number };
type OrientationTarget = { yaw: number; pitch: number; radius: number; center: Vec3Like };
type FlightState = { token: number; target: OrientationTarget; resolve: (value: boolean) => void; settled: boolean; easeCalled: boolean; maxProgress: number };

const flights = new WeakMap<GeospatialCamera, FlightState>();
let nextToken = 0;

const TWO_PI = Math.PI * 2;
const ANGLE_EPS = 1e-3;
const RADIUS_EPS = 1e-3;
const CENTER_EPS = 1e-3;
const PROGRESS_EPS = 1e-3;

function normalizeAngle(angle: number): number {
  let a = angle % TWO_PI;
  if (a > Math.PI) a -= TWO_PI;
  else if (a < -Math.PI) a += TWO_PI;
  return a;
}

function shortestAngleDiff(a: number, b: number): number {
  let d = normalizeAngle(a) - normalizeAngle(b);
  d = (d + Math.PI) % TWO_PI;
  if (d < 0) d += TWO_PI;
  d -= Math.PI;
  return Math.abs(d);
}

function finite(x: number): boolean { return Number.isFinite(x); }

function makeTarget(place: Place): OrientationTarget | null {
  if (!finite(place.yaw) || !finite(place.pitch) || !finite(place.radius) ||
      !finite(place.center.x) || !finite(place.center.y) || !finite(place.center.z)) return null;
  return {
    yaw: normalizeAngle(place.yaw),
    pitch: normalizeAngle(place.pitch),
    radius: place.radius,
    center: { x: place.center.x, y: place.center.y, z: place.center.z },
  };
}

function isAtPlace(camera: GeospatialCamera, target: OrientationTarget, easeCalled: boolean, maxProgress: number): boolean {
  if (easeCalled && maxProgress < 1 - PROGRESS_EPS) return false;
  if (!finite(camera.yaw) || !finite(camera.pitch) || !finite(camera.radius)) return false;
  if (!finite(camera.center.x) || !finite(camera.center.y) || !finite(camera.center.z)) return false;
  if (shortestAngleDiff(camera.yaw, target.yaw) > ANGLE_EPS) return false;
  if (shortestAngleDiff(camera.pitch, target.pitch) > ANGLE_EPS) return false;
  if (Math.abs(camera.radius - target.radius) > RADIUS_EPS) return false;
  if (Math.abs(camera.center.x - target.center.x) > CENTER_EPS) return false;
  if (Math.abs(camera.center.y - target.center.y) > CENTER_EPS) return false;
  if (Math.abs(camera.center.z - target.center.z) > CENTER_EPS) return false;
  return true;
}

function applyImmediately(camera: GeospatialCamera, target: OrientationTarget): void {
  try {
    camera._setOrientation(target.yaw, target.pitch, target.radius, target.center as any);
  } catch {
    try {
      camera.center = { x: target.center.x, y: target.center.y, z: target.center.z } as any;
      camera.radius = target.radius;
      camera.pitch = target.pitch;
      camera.yaw = target.yaw;
    } catch {
      // leave as-is; caller will see false if not arrived.
    }
  }
}

export function flyToPlace(camera: GeospatialCamera, scene: SceneContext, place: Place, durationMs: number): Promise<boolean> {
  return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
    const target = makeTarget(place);
    if (!target) {
      resolve(false);
      return;
    }

    const previous = flights.get(camera);
    if (previous && !previous.settled) {
      const previousArrived = isAtPlace(camera, previous.target, previous.easeCalled, previous.maxProgress);
      previous.settled = true;
      previous.resolve(previousArrived);
    }

    try {
      camera._cancelFly?.();
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }

    const state: FlightState = {
      token: ++nextToken,
      target,
      resolve,
      settled: false,
      easeCalled: false,
      maxProgress: 0,
    };
    flights.set(camera, state);

    const duration = Number.isFinite(durationMs) ? Math.max(0, durationMs) : 0;

    if (duration <= 0) {
      applyImmediately(camera, target);
      const arrived = isAtPlace(camera, target, false, 0);
      state.settled = true;
      resolve(arrived);
      return;
    }

    if (isAtPlace(camera, target, false, 0)) {
      state.settled = true;
      resolve(true);
      return;
    }

    const ease = (g: number): number => {
      if (Number.isFinite(g)) {
        state.easeCalled = true;
        if (g > state.maxProgress) state.maxProgress = g;
      }
      return g;
    };

    void (async () => {
      try {
        await flyGeospatialCameraToAsync(camera, scene, {
          yaw: target.yaw,
          pitch: target.pitch,
          radius: target.radius,
          center: target.center as any,
          durationMs: duration,
          ease,
        });

      const arrived = isAtPlace(camera, target, state.easeCalled, state.maxProgress);
      state.settled = true;
      resolve(arrived);
    })();
  });
}
